beats.say: Only ten football legends have won the Ballon d'Or more than once.
Tied on two trophies are Alfredo Di Stéfano, Franz Beckenbauer, and Kevin Keegan.
Joining them on two awards are Karl-Heinz Rummenigge and Brazil's Ronaldo.
Three icons sit above them with three wins each: Johan Cruyff, Michel Platini, and Marco van Basten.
In second place overall, Cristiano Ronaldo has lifted the trophy five times.
And clear at number one, Lionel Messi holds the record with eight Ballon d'Or wins.
Will anyone ever beat Messi's record of eight?
